_comment: VLESS Encryption test vectors. Produced by running the reference Go client and server (XTLS/Xray-core proxy/vless/encryption, commit 9514e988, verbatim except that every source of randomness is redirected to a recorded stream) against each other over loopback TCP. client_to_server / server_to_client are the complete recorded transcripts; iv, share_wires, share_secrets, pfs_public_key, mlkem_shared, x25519_shared and padding_* are the client-side values that never appear on the wire, so a reimplementation can be driven from the same inputs. All key material is synthetic and derived from fixed seeds.
